summary: F8 - install the CI-built NSIS installer on the clean VM and uninstall it, recording what is left against what was there before

coordination.notes: F8's blocked-on named E3, which merged in PR #335 with E2 and E10, so the stated blocker was gone. A different one was found in its place and fixed rather than worked around: ci.yml's tauri job built the installer and discarded it, so the artefact F8 and F9 both name had never existed on any run. PR #338 added the upload to the existing job - not a second build workflow beside it, and release.yml keeps its own tag-triggered publish, which answers a different question. tools/vm-inventory.ps1 replaces the inv.ps1 that E3 typed into the guest and left only as prose in an appendix; the E2 document is edited to point at the committed script rather than keeping a second, narrower transcription of it.
